import sqlite3 import os from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string, abort, g app = Flask(__name__) DATABASE = 'db.sqlite3' # --- Database Helper Functions --- def get_db(): if 'db' not in g: g.db = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE) g.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row return g.db def close_db(e=None): db = g.pop('db', None) if db is not None: db.close() def init_db(): db = get_db() with app.app_context(): # Create tables if they don't exist db.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS recipes ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, ingredients TEXT NOT NULL, instructions TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ''') db.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ) ''') db.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ratings ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, recipe_id TEXT NOT NULL, rating INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rating >= 1 AND rating <= 5), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (recipe_id) REFERENCES recipes(id) ) ''') db.commit() @app.teardown_appcontext def teardown_db(exception): close_db(exception) # --- HTML Templates --- RECIPE_LIST_HTML = ''' Recipe Sharing App

Recipe Sharing App

An API for uploading, rating, and commenting on recipes.

Recipe Overview

{% if recipes %}
    {% for recipe in recipes %}
  • {{ recipe.title }}
    • {% endfor %}
{% else %}

No recipes found.

{% endif %} ''' RECIPE_DETAIL_HTML = ''' {{ recipe.title }} ← Back to Recipes
{{ recipe.title }}

Ingredients:

    {% for ingredient in recipe.ingredients_split %}
  • {{ ingredient }}
    • {% endfor %}

Instructions:

{{ recipe.instructions }}

Comments ({{ recipe.comments_count }})

{% for comment in recipe.comments %}
{{ comment['comment'] }}
{% else %}

No comments yet. Be the first!

{% endfor %}br>

Ratings

Average Rating: {{ "%.1f" if recipe.avg_rating is defined else "0" }}({{ recipe.rating_sum }}/{{ recipe.rating_count * 5 }})

''' # --- API Routes --- @app.route('/recipes', methods=['GET']) def get_recipes_overview(): db = get_db() cursor = db.execute('SELECT id, title FROM recipes ORDER BY created_at DESC') recipes = cursor.fetchall() # Convert Row objects to dict for template recipes_list = [{'id': r['id'], 'title': r['title']} for r in recipes] return render_template_string(RECIPE_LIST_HTML, recipes=recipes_list) @app.route('/recipes/upload', methods=['POST']) def upload_recipe(): data = request.get_json() if not data: abort(400, description="Invalid input: JSON body required") title = data.get('title') ingredients = data.get('ingredients') instructions = data.get('instructions') if not title or not ingredients or not instructions: abort(400, description="Invalid input: Missing required fields (title, ingredients, instructions)") # Generate a simple unique ID (UUID-like or incrementing string) # Using a timestamp + random suffix for simplicity in this example import time recipe_id = str(int(time.time() * 1000)) db = get_db() try: db.execute( 'INSERT INTO recipes (id, title, ingredients, instructions) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)', (recipe_id, title, ','.join(ingredients), instructions) ) db.commit() except sqlite3.IntegrityError: abort(500, description="Server error: Failed to create recipe (ID conflict)") # Return the created recipe schema as JSON new_recipe = { 'id': recipe_id, 'title': title, 'ingredients': ingredients, 'instructions': instructions, 'comments': [], 'avgRating': None } return jsonify(new_recipe), 201 @app.route('/recipes/', methods=['GET']) def get_recipe(recipe_id): db = get_db() # Fetch recipe recipe_row = db.execute('SELECT * FROM recipes WHERE id = ?', (recipe_id,)).fetchone() if not recipe_row: abort(404, description="Recipe not found") # Fetch comments comments_rows = db.execute('SELECT comment FROM comments WHERE recipe_id = ?', (recipe_id,)).fetchall() comments = [row['comment'] for row in comments_rows] # Fetch ratings ratings_rows = db.execute('SELECT rating FROM ratings WHERE recipe_id = ?', (recipe_id,)).fetchall() ratings = [row['rating'] for row in ratings_rows] # Calculate average rating avg_rating = None rating_count = len(ratings) if rating_count > 0: avg_rating = sum(ratings) / rating_count # Prepare recipe object for template # ingredients are stored as comma-separated string ingredients_list = recipe_row['ingredients'].split(',') if recipe_row['ingredients'] else [] recipe_data = { 'id': recipe_row['id'], 'title': recipe_row['title'], 'ingredients_split': ingredients_list, 'instructions': recipe_row['instructions'], 'comments': comments, # Passing comments list 'avg_rating': avg_rating, 'rating_sum': sum(ratings) if ratings else 0, 'rating_count': rating_count } return render_template_string(RECIPE_DETAIL_HTML, recipe=recipe_data) @app.route('/recipes//comments', methods=['POST']) def add_comment(recipe_id): data = request.get_json() if not data: abort(400, description="Invalid input: JSON body required") comment = data.get('comment') if not comment: abort(400, description="Invalid input: Missing 'comment' field") db = get_db() # Check if recipe exists recipe_row = db.execute('SELECT id FROM recipes WHERE id = ?', (recipe_id,)).fetchone() if not recipe_row: abort(404, description="Recipe not found") db.execute( 'INSERT INTO comments (recipe_id, comment) VALUES (?, ?)', (recipe_id, comment) ) db.commit() # Return 201 No Content or success message return jsonify({'message': 'Comment added successfully'}), 201 @app.route('/recipes//ratings', methods=['POST']) def add_rating(recipe_id): data = request.get_json() if not data: abort(400, description="Invalid input: JSON body required") rating = data.get('rating') if rating is None: abort(400, description="Invalid input: Missing 'rating' field") # Validate range (though schema says 1-5, we check here too) if not (1 <= rating <= 5): abort(400, description="Invalid input: Rating must be between 1 and 5") db = get_db() # Check if recipe exists recipe_row = db.execute('SELECT id FROM recipes WHERE id = ?', (recipe_id,)).fetchone() if not recipe_row: abort(404, description="Recipe not found") db.execute( 'INSERT INTO ratings (recipe_id, rating) VALUES (?, ?)', (recipe_id, rating) ) db.commit() return jsonify({'message': 'Rating added successfully'}), 201 # --- Main --- if __name__ == '__main__': # Initialize database if not os.path.exists(DATABASE): init_db() # Start server app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
